failed_draft: R_marg was defined as E min_a F_a(Y) and then treated as the actual risk of the posterior-marginal selector. This incorrectly asserted V_state=R_marg-R_rob>=0.
cause: The posterior-marginal selector depends on the same probe that controls continuing common-state risk. Its actual risk is E[L_c(Y)], not E[F_c(Y)]. The signed term E[k_c(Y)^2 S(Y)] need not vanish.
correction: Retain the signed carry term in a four-term decomposition; define actual state value by E[L_c-L_u].
